title: Allow deleting links (admin only)
body:
Add `DELETE /links/:slug`.

- Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` where the token equals the server's `adminToken` option (default `$ADMIN_TOKEN`).
- Missing or wrong token → `401` and the link is not deleted.
- Unknown slug (with a valid token) → `404`.
- Success → `204`, after which `GET /<slug>` returns 404.
